caption: The drawing depicts two human figures standing side by side against a brown background filled with stylized plant forms. The figure on the left has light skin, yellow hair, and is wearing a long pink and white striped dress with short sleeves and vertical lines. The figure on the right, also with light skin and yellow-brown hair, is wearing a long blue robe with a pink collar, and has one arm extended to the right, holding a round pink and white striped object resembling a flower. Both figures have prominent, large eyes outlined in black. The plants in the background consist of tall, brown stems with orange leaves and pink, white, and red flower-like shapes at the top. On the right side near the outstretched arm, there is a cluster of round pink flowers with white centers arranged in a striped red and white vase. The overall color palette includes shades of brown, blue, pink, orange, white, and yellow, with a focus on linear patterns and repetitive motifs.
title: Panel from Rug
